description: Works without a Gameye account or token. Check game server Dockerfile text against the gameye-containerize container contract, offline: linux/amd64 base, exposed ports and protocols, exec-form launch without npm/yarn start, no loopback bind, non-root user, and no API token or credential in ENV/ARG. Returns findings with severity, rule code, line, message and fix, plus what the check cannot know. Pass the Dockerfile text itself; this tool reads no files and sends nothing.

dockerfile.description: The full Dockerfile text (not a path)

ports.description: Optional: the ports and protocols the server binds, to check against EXPOSE

protocol.description: Protocol the server binds on that port

name: gameye_check_dockerfile
title: Check Dockerfile
